description: SQL migration (schema + triggers + RLS) and strict TypeScript types matching it. Create the four relational tables with UUID PKs, timestamptz audit columns maintained by a reusable set_updated_at() trigger function, FKs to auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE, indexes on user_id/date columns, and enable RLS on all four with explicit per-command policies restricting rows to auth.uid(). Hand-write strict Database types (no any) that mirror the schema exactly (Row/Insert/Update per table + the goal_type enum). Depends on FEAT-001 (client types reference Database).
steps: Create apps/macros-web/supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql. Enable pgcrypto (for gen_random_uuid) if needed. Define a goal_type enum type ('deficit','mantenimiento','volumen'). Define reusable function public.set_updated_at() returning trigger that sets NEW.updated_at = now().

profiles table: id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE (1:1), display_name text, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). BEFORE UPDATE trigger -> set_updated_at.

macro_goals table: id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, goal_type goal_type NOT NULL, tdee integer NOT NULL CHECK (tdee > 0), calorie_target integer NOT NULL CHECK (calorie_target > 0), protein_g integer NOT NULL CHECK (protein_g >= 0), fat_g integer NOT NULL CHECK (fat_g >= 0), carbs_g integer NOT NULL CHECK (carbs_g >= 0), is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, created_at/updated_at timestamptz. Partial unique index UNIQUE (user_id) WHERE is_active to enforce one active goal per user (document this 'single active goal' choice). Index on (user_id, created_at desc). BEFORE UPDATE trigger.

weight_logs table: id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL FK auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE, weight_kg numeric(5,2) NOT NULL CHECK (weight_kg > 0), logged_on date NOT NULL DEFAULT current_date, note text, created_at/updated_at timestamptz. Index on (user_id, logged_on desc). BEFORE UPDATE trigger.

food_logs table (structured daily intake): id uuid PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), user_id uuid NOT NULL FK auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE, logged_on date NOT NULL DEFAULT current_date, name text NOT NULL, quantity numeric(8,2) NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0), unit text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'g', calories integer NOT NULL CHECK (calories >= 0), protein_g numeric(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (protein_g >= 0), fat_g numeric(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fat_g >= 0), carbs_g numeric(6,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (carbs_g >= 0), created_at/updated_at timestamptz. Index on (user_id, logged_on desc). BEFORE UPDATE trigger.

RLS: ALTER TABLE ... ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on all four tables. For profiles write 4 policies keyed by id = auth.uid(): SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id); INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id); UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id) WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = id); DELETE USING (auth.uid() = id). For macro_goals/weight_logs/food_logs write the same 4 policies keyed by user_id = auth.uid() (INSERT WITH CHECK, UPDATE USING+WITH CHECK). Name policies clearly per table+command.
Add a header comment block in the SQL documenting: run order in the Supabase SQL editor, the single-active-goal choice, and that these policies make authorization server-side (not client-side).

Create apps/macros-web/src/data/database.types.ts: a hand-written strict `Database` type (public schema) with Tables.{profiles,macro_goals,weight_logs,food_logs}.{Row,Insert,Update} and Enums.goal_type = 'deficit'|'mantenimiento'|'volumen'. Insert types make server-defaulted columns optional (id/created_at/updated_at/is_active defaults). NO any. Add a top comment documenting the optional `supabase gen types typescript --project-id <id> > database.types.ts` regen path without depending on the CLI.
acceptance_criteria: 0001_init.sql defines all four tables with UUID PKs, timestamptz created_at/updated_at, set_updated_at() trigger wired BEFORE UPDATE on each table, FKs to auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE, and the goal_type enum.
Every table has RLS enabled and exactly four per-command policies (SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) scoped to auth.uid(); INSERT policies use WITH CHECK and UPDATE policies use USING + WITH CHECK.
database.types.ts compiles under strict TS with no `any` and its Row/enum shapes match the SQL columns and the goal_type values.
A single-active-goal mechanism exists (partial unique index on macro_goals) and is documented.
verification: Static SQL sanity: confirm 4x ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, 16 CREATE POLICY statements, WITH CHECK on every INSERT/UPDATE policy, and ON DELETE CASCADE on every auth.users FK (grep review).
A database-savvy review pass validates auth.uid() usage, WITH CHECK presence, and cascade behavior.
